scripts.generate-tolgee-data: cd ../.. && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_GAME_ID=145 npm run generate-tolgee-data && cd packages/plinko
scripts.dev: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_GAME_ID=145 npm run generate-tolgee-data && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_GAME_ID=145 NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH= PORT=3003 FAST_REFRESH=false node custom-server.js
scripts.build:standalone: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_GAME_ID=145 npm run generate-tolgee-data && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/game-145 next build
scripts.start: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_GAME_ID=145 NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH= PORT=3003 node custom-server.js
